title: Getting there on purpose
content: I never imagined I would even think to tell anyone about my “shopping” dreams, until the sub popped up randomly, like it seems it has for a lot of us. One of the few things that I have always realized about the place is that I can only get there after a very traumatic nightmare, usually during a time when I’m going through bad stuff in real life. Another thing I remember is how real the people there seemed and yet, how unlike me, and how I could shape the mall any way I liked. For the past few years, I’ve taken a mood stabilizer that truly changed my life for the better…except that I don’t dream. It knocks me out and I sleep very peacefully, with no more nightmares, and with meditation helping to keep my peace during the day. But (hear me out) if it’s a metaphysical place, could I help myself to find it, either in dreams or during meditation? Is there even a connection between the mall and the stuff you encounter in meditation?
